parts.text: dilute ethanoic acid at two different temperatures. Instructions Fig. 2.1 Experiment 1 ● 3 of dilute ethanoic acid into a conical flask. ● the initial temperature. ● water. ● cylinder. ● conical flask and start the timer. If the magnesium sticks to the side of the flask, gently shake the flask so that it is washed off the side. ● 150 seconds. Record the volume of gas collected. ● record the final temperature. ● Experiment 2 ● ° C after it has been poured into the conical flask and before the initial temperature is measured and recorded.
